Download: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B18BFpNIWcVERU5taU9oLXg0MFk

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hey there, mate.

And greetings from Czech Republic.

Are you playing Starsector?
Are you bored, crushed by strong factions (like Knights Templar) or just curious to try new hull ?

In that case, I can provide you with adequate substitute for your obsolete fleets in just ONE ship.

I call it, BISMARCK.
- 1st grade armor n´ super-durable hull.
- Avesome maneuverability, speed over 200su, burn 18.
- Monstrously high flux capacity, 360° shield coverage.
- 100 fleet points, 5000 ordnance points limit (cca. 6500 with skills affection)
- Value 19 milion cr.
-17500 cargo, 5000 fuel
-Single flight deck

- Weapon mounts:
74 small universal
30 medium universal
17 large universal
20 medium missile
4 large missile

ENJOY

(Feel free to edit this mod as much as you like)

PS.: Version of game doesnt matter. Its like any other mods - should work in later releases.

aiDescription: Provides a single large ship designed to replace obsolete fleets. It features 1st grade armor, super-durable hull, and extensive weapon mount slots including small, medium, large, and missile mounts. The ship has high maneuverability, speed over 200su, burn 18, and 360° shield coverage.
